en.title: Adult Scream Mask | Classic Ghost Face Slasher, Horror Movie Killer Costume Accessory
en.description:
Product Description 
 Welcome to the Fog… but who's that emerging from the shadows? It's none other than the iconic Ghost Face, ready to claim his next victim. Whether you're preparing for a night of frights or setting the perfect horror movie scene, the Adult Scream Mask is your ultimate ticket to slasher infamy. Straight from the cult classic Scream series, this mask brings that spine-chilling fear to life; no phone call required. Slip on the white foam mask and feel the cold stare of Ghost Face take over. The exaggerated, haunting expression is captured in terrifying detail, framed by a flowing black shroud that drapes over your head and shoulders. The lightweight design makes it easy to stalk through the night; though we can't promise anyone will stick around when they see you. After all, Ghost Face isn't exactly known for making friends. From horror movie marathons to midnight mayhem, this mask is an instant scream-worthy statement. Pair it with your darkest cloak or a casual black hoodie to complete the classic look. Planning to wield a fake knife and reenact your favorite slasher scenes? Just remember, in the Fog, everyone is fair game. But hey, if the innocent bystanders don't recognize the mask, are they even worth chasing? Perfect for horror fans, pranksters, and the bravest souls who dare attend a themed party, the Adult Scream Mask turns every setting into a scene straight from Dead by Daylight or the big screen. But watch your back; because when the lights go out, Ghost Face might not be the only one lurking. So… what's your favorite scary mask? - Mask with Shroud
